headline: Going Commando reaches 66.51% matched code on USA v1.01
summary: Contributors brought more Yeedil, Aranos prison and shared game routines into matching C. A matched function compiles to exactly the original game's bytes. The project's final progress report puts USA v1.01 at 66.51% matched code by size and 7,152 of 8,578 functions. Its separate function totals are 6,692 of 8,634 for USA v2.00 and 4,995 of 8,672 for PAL.
highlights: #381 matches 44 USA v1.01 functions: 29 in Yeedil, 11 in Aranos prison and four shared routines.
Two routines cover Dobbo on both USA releases and Snivelak on both USA releases and PAL (#372). Four more routines and a repaired callback catalogue entry landed through #373.
Object-slot lookup and the hero's held-object positioning now have matching C (#370, #371).

One Yeedil routine remains assembly on PAL and USA v2.00 because its C matches USA v1.01 only. Closed proposals for movie, text and overlay routines must not be counted as merged work (#375, #378, #379, #380, #382).
